profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin | University of Maryland Graduate
profile.summary: Software Engineer looking to gain valuable experience and hone my current skill set. Three years of industry experience with modern languages and technologies. Maintaining a Top Secret level DoD security clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Worked in an agile environment along with a team of developers on the Air Force’s DRRS application. Communicated daily with product owners on desired implementation.
- Developed in React, Lit, and Javascript on the frontend of the application, along with spending time enhancing skills in UI/UX design.
- Monitored and troubleshot application performance issues using Redux DevTools and refactored existing code to improve performance and maintainability.
- Constructed the backend of our application primarily in C#. Designed schema to efficiently store and access information within our database.
- Created tables and procedures in Microsoft SQL Server for various parts of the application.
- Coordinated tasks, directives, development, and deployment through Microsoft Azure and Git.

positions.title: Junior Systems Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Conceptualized, designed, and constructed an internal application for training on-boarding engineers.
- Worked alongside current AWS team members in an agile development cycle where we would meet weekly to discuss current objectives and future necessities.
- Designed and implemented programming assignments in Python, Java, and AWS CDK which allowed
on-boarding engineers to submit code and have it tested by our application.
- Constructed our application’s front-end in React using AWS Polaris components and CSS.
- Designed our service’s DynamoDB table and actively used it when storing and requesting data from our
application’s front-end.
- Communicated with division leaders to gauge interest and notate requests for our application.

positions.title: Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Led a team of six interns in the creation of a secure baseline for current DoD Linux systems.
- Prepared and delegated tasks to team members; Kept track of individuals’ progress for weekly reports.
- Created and conducted progress presentations for in depth work overviews directly with our government client
- Organized team’s scripts and code over AWS servers for proper safety and ease of access.
